title: Glowing Egg in Thorns
description: A large cracked egg emits a bright pink glow revealing a smiling sun face inside. It is surrounded by dark thorny brambles, holly leaves with red berries, and a broken red sphere at its base against a solid black background.
prompt: A surreal dark painting of a large cracked egg glowing bright pink from within, revealing a smiling sun with a face inside. The egg is wrapped in sharp black thorns, holly leaves, and red berries. A broken red orb and scattered berries lie at the bottom. Solid black background, high contrast, magical and eerie atmosphere.
